name: no-status
description: Suppress transient status messages that pi appends to the interactive chat log, such as reload/resume/model switch notices.

replacements.old: async handleClearCommand(){this.clearStatusIndicator();try{if((await this.runtimeHost.newSession()).cancelled)return;this.chatContainer.addChild(new Spacer(1)),this.chatContainer.addChild(new Text(`${theme.fg("accent","\u2713 New session started")}`,1,1)),this.ui.requestRender()}catch(error){await this.handleFatalRuntimeError("Failed to create session",error)}}
